answer: Bindings are kept in nebula, verified in spiral, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the whisper check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history therefore fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Scaling to 726 identities multiplies that fee by 496 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
